intro: This privacy policy applies only to the specific FullParty site or service where it is published. If you are using a self-hosted or forked copy of FullParty, the operator of that instance must replace or adapt this policy so it accurately reflects their own data practices.

FullParty helps FFXIV communities manage characters, groups, applications, runs, rosters, resources and feedback. This policy also covers the official FullParty Discord bot, FFXIV plugin and the FullParty APIs they use. Independently operated services, including Discord and Square Enix, have their own privacy policies.

sections.title: Who we are
paragraphs: {operator_details}
If you have questions about this privacy policy or want to exercise your data protection rights, you can contact us at {contact}.

sections.title: What information we collect
bullets: Account information: email address, username, password hash if you set a password, avatar and preferences; linked login-provider identifiers and the profile details returned by providers such as Google, Discord and XIVAuth.

Character and progression information: character name, world, datacenter, Lodestone identifiers, portraits, jobs, account links, verification state, and encounter or milestone information obtained from Lodestone, XIVAuth or FF Logs.

Community information: memberships, applications and answers, roster assignments, attendance, group notes, resources, uploaded images, reports, evidence snapshots, moderation decisions and audit records.

Feedback information: survey answers and response revisions, linked to your account when signed in or to a browser identifier for guest responses. A guest response is not necessarily anonymous, especially if its answers identify you.

Communication and integration information: notification preferences, message content, delivery and read status, Discord user/server links, plugin authorizations, access tokens, and records of supported integration actions.

Technical and abuse-prevention information: IP addresses, browser/device information, sessions, request metadata and security logs. Guest resource reports use a pseudonymous identifier derived from your IP address or network to limit repeat submissions; this is not a guarantee of anonymity.

sections.title: Where information comes from
bullets: You, when you use the website, official bot or plugin, submit an application, complete a survey, report content or contact us.
Login and account-linking providers when you choose to connect them.

Lodestone, XIVAuth and FF Logs when characters are added or verified, progression is refreshed, or relevant application and run features are used. These lookups can be triggered by a moderator reviewing an application or by run-management features, not only by a request from the character's account holder.
Other users and authorised moderators who manage groups, applications, attendance, rosters, notes and reports involving your account or character.

sections.title: Why we use information and our lawful bases
bullets: Requested service features: account access, character management, applications, groups, runs, rosters and related notifications. Where processing is necessary to perform our service agreement with you, we rely on Article 6(1)(b) GDPR.

Service operation and safety: securing accounts, preventing spam, reviewing reports, moderating groups, keeping an accountable activity history, diagnosing errors and improving usability, including through voluntary feedback. We rely on our legitimate interests in providing a reliable and safe community service, subject to your interests and rights (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR).
Legal obligations: responding to binding legal requirements where applicable (Article 6(1)(c) GDPR).

Consent: where a particular use requires consent, it must be requested separately and can be withdrawn. Choosing an optional login connection or receiving a service notification does not by itself mean that consent is the lawful basis for every related use.
paragraphs: Information needed for a feature is requested as part of that feature. Without the relevant account, character or application information, we may be unable to provide it. Optional profile details and voluntary feedback are not required to use unrelated features.

We do not sell personal information or use website advertising or visitor-analytics tools. Operational security logs, delivery records and progression records still exist for the purposes described here.

sections.title: Who can see your information
bullets: Group owners and authorised moderators can access information needed to manage their group and runs, including applications, selected characters, progression, attendance and moderation notes.

Other participants, group members or public visitors can see information made available through the relevant profile, group, resource or roster visibility settings. A character name or roster placement may be visible even when other account details are private.
Authorised site administrators can review survey responses, reports and captured evidence, handle support and moderation, and investigate operational problems.

The official Discord bot receives the data needed for enabled features, such as Discord identifiers, character names and images, schedules, assignments and notification content. Information posted to a server can be seen by people with access to its channel; administrator alerts can include report references and relevant diagnostic details.

The authorised FFXIV plugin receives account, character, group, run and roster data within its access permissions and can submit supported actions. API access remains subject to authentication, scopes and the relevant user's permissions.
A recipient may retain a message or copy outside FullParty. Deleting an account does not automatically recall messages already delivered to email or Discord.

sections.title: Service providers and external content
bullets: Hetzner hosts the official website, database, stored files, Discord bot and supporting services.
Postmark delivers service emails and processes recipient addresses, message content and delivery information.
Cloudflare provides network delivery and security services and can process connection and request information.
Google, Discord and XIVAuth handle the login or account connections you choose. Discord also processes bot interactions and messages on its platform.
Square Enix's Lodestone, XIVAuth and FF Logs supply character, verification or progression information. Relevant character identifiers are sent when making those requests.

YouTube and Twitch provide embedded videos. YouTube thumbnails can be requested before you press play; the video player is loaded when you start playback. These requests disclose connection information such as your IP address to the provider.
Professional advisers, regulators or law enforcement may receive information where there is a lawful and necessary reason.
paragraphs: External providers also process information under their own terms and privacy notices. Hosting FullParty on Hetzner does not mean that data sent to email, authentication, video or Discord services stays on Hetzner.

sections.title: International processing
paragraphs: External providers may process information outside the European Economic Area, including in the United States. The location and protections depend on the provider and service involved.

Postmark and Cloudflare publish data-processing terms describing their international-transfer arrangements, including the EU-US Data Privacy Framework where applicable and European Commission Standard Contractual Clauses. Their current terms are linked below. You can contact {contact} for information about the arrangements applicable to your data and available safeguards.

sections.title: Retention and account deletion
paragraphs: Account information is retained while your account is in use. Historical applications, runs, attendance, audit, moderation and feedback records do not currently have a general automatic expiry simply because a run ends or an account becomes inactive. They support participation history, moderation, dispute handling and service accountability.

The account-deletion feature removes or replaces account profile and login details, ends account access, removes specified links and notifications, and releases linked characters. It does not erase all historical records, uploaded content or messages already delivered elsewhere.

You can request broader erasure at {contact}. We assess the information concerned, whether it is still necessary, and any applicable legal exceptions, such as protecting other people's rights or handling legal claims. Keeping data cannot be justified solely by the absence of a deletion request.

Server logs, delivery-provider records and backups follow the relevant operational or provider retention arrangements; deleting live account data does not necessarily remove every backup copy immediately. Contact us for the arrangements relevant to a request. Browser-storage lifetimes are explained in the Cookie Policy.

sections.title: Your rights and choices
paragraphs: Subject to the applicable conditions, you can ask to access, correct, erase, restrict or receive a portable copy of your personal information, and object to processing based on legitimate interests. You may withdraw consent where consent is the basis, without affecting processing already lawfully carried out.

You can manage available profile visibility, notification and account-connection settings in FullParty. Disconnecting an integration or changing a preference does not automatically erase historical records or third-party messages.

Contact {contact} to exercise your rights. We may request proportionate information to verify your identity and locate the records. We normally respond within one month; if a lawful extension is needed, we explain it within that period.

sections.title: Younger players
paragraphs: Age requirements for FFXIV, Discord and other external services apply to those services. Playing FFXIV does not by itself establish consent for FullParty's processing of personal information.
Younger users and parents or guardians can contact {contact} with questions or concerns about personal information held by FullParty.

sections.title: How to complain
paragraphs: You can contact us at {contact} with concerns, but you do not have to contact us before exercising your right to complain to a supervisory authority.

You can raise a concern with Ireland's Data Protection Commission, or another competent authority, including the authority where you habitually live or work in the EU/EEA. UK users can also contact the Information Commissioner's Office.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We update the date on this page when the policy changes. Where required, we also bring material changes in how we use personal information to your attention.

intro: This cookie policy applies only to the specific FullParty site or service where it is published. Self-hosted or forked copies of FullParty should replace or adapt this page so it accurately describes their own cookie and storage usage.

This policy explains browser storage used by the FullParty website, including website sign-in and authorization pages opened from the official Discord bot or FFXIV plugin. It does not describe storage used independently by the Discord app, FFXIV or external websites.
FullParty does not use website advertising or visitor-analytics tools. The storage below supports sign-in, security, preferences, survey participation and editor recovery.

sections.title: Cookies and browser storage
paragraphs: Cookies are small values stored in your browser and sent with relevant web requests. Local storage keeps data on your device across visits; session storage normally lasts for the current tab session. Browser settings, private browsing and session restoration can affect their lifetime.

The following first-party storage is managed by FullParty. Expiry is measured from when a cookie is set or renewed, so continued use may extend its expiry. Clearing browser storage may remove it sooner.

sections.title: First-party cookies
bullets: {session_cookie}: maintains your session, sign-in and temporary workflow state. Cookie lifetime: {session_duration}. The server's inactivity limit is {session_minutes} minutes.
XSRF-TOKEN: helps protect form submissions against cross-site request forgery. Lifetime: {session_minutes} minutes, renewed during use.
remember_web_*: keeps you signed in when you choose the remember-me option. Lifetime: up to 400 days; signing out invalidates the relevant remembered login.
locale: remembers the language of the first localized page you open, or your later language selection. Lifetime: up to 400 days, renewed when the preference is remembered.
fullparty_overview_plain_dps, fullparty_overview_numbered_parties and fullparty_overview_alliance_progress: save roster-display choices when changed. Lifetime: 365 days.

fullparty_forms: identifies a guest browser for survey response limits and access to its response where supported. Lifetime: 365 days. It is a random browser identifier, not proof of a person's identity.

sections.title: Local storage
paragraphs: These entries have no automatic expiry in the application. They remain until cleared by you, your browser or the application.
bullets: fullparty-appearance and resource-reader-appearance: remember light/dark display preferences.
fullparty-changelog-read: remembers the latest changelog read by a guest.
fullparty.system_banner.collapsed.* and fullparty.development_notice.dismissed: remember collapsed or dismissed notices. The suffix distinguishes a particular banner version.

sections.title: Session storage
bullets: resource-draft:*: stores unsaved resource content and recovery information in the editor's tab. It is removed when the relevant draft is cleared by the application or the tab session ends, subject to browser session restoration.

resource-edit:*: stores resource-editing tokens used to coordinate the current editor session. These are cleared by the editor when released or when the tab session ends, subject to browser session restoration.
paragraphs: Clearing this storage can discard unsaved edits. Clearing cookies alone does not necessarily clear local or session storage.

sections.title: Cloudflare and third-party services
paragraphs: Cloudflare security features may set cookies when the relevant protection is active. Examples include __cf_bm for bot protection (30 minutes of inactivity) and cf_clearance for security-challenge results (duration depends on the configured challenge settings). Cloudflare documents its cookies and purposes at the link below.

YouTube thumbnails can contact Google's servers before playback. Playing an embedded YouTube or Twitch video loads that provider's player, which may use its own storage and process connection or viewing information. Signing in with an external provider or following an external link also subjects that interaction to the provider's own storage practices.

sections.title: Preferences and consent
paragraphs: Authentication and request-security storage supports the service you request. Other entries remember feature choices or preserve work in progress. A choice to save a preference is not permission for unrelated advertising or tracking.

The absence of analytics does not make every use of browser storage automatically exempt from consent requirements. Consent requirements depend on the purpose and applicable law, including for embedded third-party services.
If we introduce optional analytics, advertising or other tracking that requires consent, we will explain it and obtain the required consent before using it, with a way to withdraw consent.

sections.title: Managing browser storage
paragraphs: You can change available preferences in FullParty and inspect or remove cookies, local storage and session storage through your browser's site-data settings. Blocking essential storage may prevent sign-in or secure submissions; clearing preferences can reset your display choices or cause notices to reappear.

Deleting the guest survey cookie may prevent the browser from recognizing its earlier response. Clearing site data does not delete server-side account, application or survey records; contact us to request erasure.
External providers manage storage on their own domains. Use their controls and your browser settings for those services.
